eBay | Product, Engineering, Data Science | Bengaluru, India | ONSITE (hybrid)

I'm a PM on the Bengaluru team and can refer strong candidates directly into our internal portal - the referral just has to go in BEFORE you apply, so reach out first.

Open right now: 6 product reqs (PM Assisted Service, PM Tax Platform, Senior PM II, Group PM Product Knowledge, Sr PM Case Management), ~16 engineering (MTS/Sr MTS, platform, SRE, AI platform), ~9 data science, plus Sr UX Designer (mobile). Full list: https://jobs.ebayinc.com/us/en/search-results - filter country = India.

To get referred: email rsk2111999@gmail.com with the req ID, your resume (PDF), and one line on fit. One req per person - pick the one that genuinely matches. If you applied to eBay in the last ~3 months, a referral won't count.

Valkyrie Aero | Software Engineer (Autonomy, Perception, Frontend) | REMOTE (US) | Contract | U.S. Citizens | https://valkyrieaero.com

Valkyrie Aero is a DoD prime contractor. We're building an airborne system for a manned counter-drone aircraft (that we operate) to enable a crew to find and engage Group 2-3 drones at low cost. Hiring contract software engineers for three roles:

- Software Engineer, Autonomy

- Software Engineer, Perception

- Software Engineer, Frontend (HMI)

We’re a small team (for now) so this isn’t your traditional defense program. Bureaucracy kept to the absolute minimum. If you can work across more than one of these domains that’s a huge plus.

I'm on the engineering team and read every application myself. I do not use AI to screen your applications and will read and reply to every single one; but please don’t send over walls of LLM generated text, I’d much rather be communicating with humans!

Apply: https://valkyrie-aero.breezy.hr/ and mention HN in your application.
